doc_title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 2027年3月期　配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: Recent business performance; commitment to stable long-term dividend policy with enhanced shareholder returns

summary_en: Interim dividend raised to ¥50/share (from ¥45), period-end dividend raised to ¥50/share (from ¥45). Combined FY3/27 payout ¥100/share vs ¥90 prior guidance. Prior period (FY3/26) paid ¥85/share.
summary_jp: 中間配当を¥50/株に増配（前回¥45より）、期末配当を¥50/株に増配（前回¥45より）。合計年間配当¥100/株対前回¥90。前期実績¥85/株。
tag_en: Dividend Hike – FY3/27 – ¥50/50 (H1/FY) vs ¥45/45 prior guidance – ¥100 annual
